# /onboarding/story

Step 5 of 7 in first-run onboarding, reached only from the typed branch of
`/onboarding/story-select`. A person writes the caption for the creature
they drew on the canvas step, with that drawing shown above the input as a
reminder of what they are writing about.

## At a glance

| Property | Value |
|----------|-------|
| Route | `/onboarding/story` |
| Router file | `app/onboarding/story.tsx` |
| Flows | F2 First-run onboarding, F3 Invite and join |
| Position in flow | step 5 of 7, typed-story branch only |
| Data calls | none. No read, no write call |
| Shared surface | `DrawingImage`, also used across wall/family/response/share screens |

Cited to hs2studio/scribl-app at `c1b3c2d` on `main`, clean tree.

This tile shows the screen's real interface, not a redirect artifact. But
what it shows in the drawing card is not the creature drawn on
`/onboarding/canvas`; it is a generic orange sun glyph. That is a finding,
not something to smooth over, and the rest of this page traces it as far as
the source in this repo allows.

## Features

| Feature | Where it lives |
|---------|-----------------|
| See the drawing from the canvas step above the input | `app/onboarding/story.tsx:59-67` |
| Type a caption up to 280 characters, with a live counter | `app/onboarding/story.tsx:94-109`, limit from `STORY_MAX_LENGTH` (`src/lib/storyLimits.ts`) |
| Submit and advance to `/onboarding/walls` | `app/onboarding/story.tsx:39-42`, button at `:49-51` |

There is no back button and no skip, same as `/onboarding/story-select`; the
`OnboardingFrame` footer holds only the Share button
(`app/onboarding/story.tsx:45-53`), so the affordance is absent from the
source.

### The sun glyph: what is confirmed and what is not

`app/onboarding/story.tsx` reads the drawing from the draft store correctly.
`draftImageRef` is pulled from `useDraftStore((state) => state.imageRef)`
(`app/onboarding/story.tsx:25`) and passed straight into `DrawingImage` as
`imageRef` (`app/onboarding/story.tsx:60`). `DrawingImage`
(`components/DrawingImage.tsx:31-57`) renders an `<Image>` from that ref when
it is truthy, and only falls back to its `fallback` prop when `imageRef` is
falsy (`components/DrawingImage.tsx:32-34`). This screen's fallback is
`<Doodle kind="crayon" .../>` (`app/onboarding/story.tsx:62-66`), not a sun:
the `crayon` path in `components/art/Doodle.tsx:34-35` draws a pointed-top
rectangle with two crossbars, a crayon shape. The `sun` path, a circle with
eight radiating lines (`components/art/Doodle.tsx:33`), is a different
`DoodleKind` that nothing on this screen requests.

So the glyph in the tile cannot be this screen's own fallback rendering; the
shapes do not match. That leaves the `<Image>` branch: `imageRef` was
truthy at capture time and resolved to an image whose content is a sun, not
the person's drawn creature. Why `imageRef` held a sun image is not
answered by anything in this repo at `c1b3c2d`. The capture was taken from
`72c3ab8`, an unmerged flow-map branch not present at this commit, whose
whole job is to seed a draft before visiting draft-guarded routes; whatever
value that seed script wrote into `imageRef` is not visible from here. This
is recorded as undiagnosed rather than asserted: the read-and-render path in
`app/onboarding/story.tsx:25` and `:59-67` is confirmed correct, and the
`crayon`-vs-`sun` mismatch is confirmed, but the seed data itself could not
be traced past this commit.

## Data calls

No call, no read, no write. Reading `app/onboarding/story.tsx` in full,
nothing on this screen touches `httpDataClient` (`src/data/http.ts`); it
reads and writes only local state and `useDraftStore`.

## State in, state out

**Reads on entry.** `useDraftStore((state) => state.imageRef)`
(`app/onboarding/story.tsx:25`), used both for the guard and for the drawing
preview.

**Writes on mount.** `useOnboardingStep("story")`
(`app/onboarding/story.tsx:23`) persists the step name to AsyncStorage under
a per-user key (`src/lib/useOnboardingStep.ts:16-18`,
`src/stores/useOnboardingStore.ts:220`).

**Writes on exit.** `useDraftStore.getState().setCaption(story)`
(`app/onboarding/story.tsx:40`), then `router.push("/onboarding/walls")`
(`app/onboarding/story.tsx:41`).

### The draft guard, same pattern as story-select

`story` is also in `DRAFT_REQUIRED_STEPS` (`src/lib/onboardingFlow.ts:34`).
This screen carries its own copy of the guard rather than relying solely on
`resumeStep()`/`resumeTarget` (`src/lib/onboardingFlow.ts:53-60`,
`src/stores/useOnboardingStore.ts:246`): a mount effect checks
`draftImageRef` directly and calls `router.replace("/onboarding/canvas")`
when it is falsy, with the same "deep link / cold resume" comment as
`story-select.tsx` (`app/onboarding/story.tsx:32-33`).

## Components

| Component | Path |
|-----------|------|
| `OnboardingFrame`, the shared onboarding chrome, heading and footer button | `components/onboarding/OnboardingFrame.tsx`, imported at `app/onboarding/story.tsx:11` |
| `DrawingImage`, renders the stored drawing or its fallback | `components/DrawingImage.tsx`, imported at `app/onboarding/story.tsx:10` |
| `Doodle`, the line-art fallback glyph | `components/art/Doodle.tsx`, imported at `app/onboarding/story.tsx:9` |
| `useAspectFitSize` / `useDrawingAspectRatio`, sizes the drawing box to the drawing's own aspect ratio | `components/art/useDrawingAspectRatio.ts`, imported at `app/onboarding/story.tsx:12` |

`DrawingImage` is shared across wall, family, response and share screens per
its own doc comment (`components/DrawingImage.tsx:14-15`); any change to how
it resolves a missing `imageRef` lands on all of them, not just onboarding.

## Notes for planning

Authored here, not read out of the app.

### The sun-glyph finding needs a live check, not just a source read

The source shows a correct read-render path and a fallback that does not
match what the tile shows. That combination points at seed data on the
unmerged capture branch rather than a bug in this screen, but that is an
inference from elimination, not a confirmed cause. Before anyone treats this
as "fixed" or "not a bug," it is worth running the flow live (main, with a
real drawing carried through from the canvas step) and confirming the
creature renders. If it does, the sun is a capture-tooling artifact and
belongs in the capture script's backlog, not this screen's. If it does not,
this screen has a real defect the source read did not surface.

### Two draft guards again, same risk as story-select

Same duplication noted on `/onboarding/story-select`: the guard is
hand-written here too, not delegated to `resumeStep`. Repeating a judgement
rather than re-deriving it: three separate copies of the same
falsy-imageRef check is the kind of thing that drifts quietly when one
screen's guard condition changes and the others are not updated to match.

### No caption length feedback beyond the counter

`STORY_MAX_LENGTH` clamps at 280 with a numeric counter but no visual warning
as a person approaches the limit (compare `app/onboarding/story.tsx:94-109`
to whatever `/write.tsx` does with the same constant, not verified here).
For a first-run screen where the person cannot yet know the limit exists
until they hit it, a plain counter is a minimal affordance. Worth revisiting
once the product has real copy to test against, not urgent for the POC.
